company.name: Classtap
company.shortDescription: Classtap platform that provides access to multiple gyms and studios through one membership, providing variety and flexibility of workouts.
company.description:
Classtap is a lifestyle company that provides access to multiple gyms and studios with one membership and through one app. It connects members to a variety of fitness experiences including yoga, boxing, Pilates, HIIT, Spinning and more. Classtap motivates customers to lead healthy lifestyles by inspiring, introducing and connecting them to new fitness experiences. It facilitates this by partnering with gyms, studios, hotels and wellness providers and through its platform members can discover and book fitness classes and day passes to gyms. Classtap helps its partners reach new customer segments and increase their revenue by marketing and filling up their excess inventory.

The company was founded in 2020 and headquartered in Doha, Qatar.
